title: 物理化学
subtitle: Physical Chemistry
keywords: Amount of substance 2.Structure of atoms 3.Electron configuration 4.Periodic law 5.Molecular bond
educationalGoal: Three general objectives will be addressed in this course: -Fundamental understandings of the structure of substances. -Ability to solve problems using knowledge gained above-mentioned. -Ability to apply the method of inquiry used by chemists to solve chemical problems
advice: There will be three one-hour examinations during the term and a regularly scheduled final examination. The exercise sheets will be also distributed in the class. All the exams will be closed-notes and closed-book, although the key equations will be provided on the exam sheets. Tutorial classes will be held regularly in the library.
books: Peter Atkins, Elements of Physical Chemistry 7th Edition, Oxford University Press
requiredKnowledge: 1. Fundamentals of physics and mathematics 2. Fundamentals of high-school level chemistry

activityGoals.body: Use of the SI and other units to indicate a magnitude of a quantity, in particular to indicate the amount of mat
Understandings of the structure of atoms and electric configurations.
Understandings of the Periodic Law and properties of elements based on the periodic table.
Understandings of the three phases of matter.

achievementLevels.ideal: -Able to use the SI and other units to indicate the magnitude of matter quantities. -Able to explain the structure of atoms and apply the knowledge to solve complex problems. -Able to explain the Periodic Law and apply the knowledge to solve complex problems. -Able to explain chemical bonds and apply the knowledge to solve complex problems. -Able to explain three phases of matter and apply the knowledge to solve complex problems.
achievementLevels.standard: -Able to use the SI and other units to indicate the magnitude of matter quantities. -Able to explain the structure of atoms. -Able to explain the Periodic Law. -Able to explain chemical bonds. -Able to explain the three phases of matter.

lessons.content: 1 Introduction I Matter and chemistry Introductory lesson on the role of chemistry in human society
lessons.assignments: Read the relevant part of the textbook beforehand and prepare to be able to answer the exercise problems.

lessons.content: Introduction II Description of the amount of matter -mole and Avogadro number -molecular weight and molar mass -mass Atoms -atomic number -mass number
lessons.assignments: Read the relevant part of the textbook beforehand and prepare to be able to answer the exercise problems.

lessons.content: Structure and spectra of hydrogenic atoms I -outline of electron configuration of atoms -spectra of hydrogenic atoms
lessons.assignments: Read the relevant part of the textbook beforehand and prepare to be able to answer the exercise problems

lessons.content: 4 Structure and spectra of hydrogenic atoms II -electron energy levels -spectra of hydrogenic atoms Electromagnetic wave and energy -relation among energy, wavelength, and frequency of a photon -calculation of wavelength and energy of spectra from atomic hydrogen
lessons.assignments: Read the relevant part of the textbook beforehand and prepare to be able to answer the exercise problems. 60 60

lessons.content: Short test Introduction to quantum theory -a particle in an one-dimensional box -Schrodinger equation -normalized wavefunctions of a particle in a box -allowed energy levels
lessons.assignments: Prepare for the short test. Read the relevant part of the textbook beforehand and prepare to be able to answer the exercise problems.

lessons.content: Electron configuration of hydrogenic atoms I -description of electron orbitals -shells and subshells -s, p, and d orbitals and shapes -degenerate energy levels
lessons.assignments: Read the relevant part of the textbook beforehand and prepare to be able to answer the exercise problems.

lessons.content: Electron configuration of hydrogenic atoms II (the structure of single-electron atoms) -the Pauli principles and Hund's rules
lessons.assignments: Read the relevant part of the textbook beforehand and prepare to be able to answer the exercise problems.

lessons.content: Electron configuration of hydrogenic atoms III (the structure of many-electron atoms) -resolving of the degeneracy -description of electron configuration table -penetration and shieldings -ionization energy and electron affinities
lessons.assignments: Read the relevant part of the textbook beforehand and prepare to be able to answer the exercise problems.

lessons.content: Short test Principles of quantum chemistry
Materials and chemical bonds -types of chemical bonds -cohesion -ionic bonds -metals
lessons.assignments: Read the relevant part of the textbook beforehand and prepare to be able to answer the exercise problems.

lessons.content: Molecular orbitals -hydrogen molecule -spatial wavefunction -the structure of hydrogen molecular ion -bonding orbitals and antibonding orbitals -σ and π orbitals
lessons.assignments: Read the relevant part of the textbook beforehand and prepare to be able to answer the exercise problems.

lessons.content: Solid -metals and metallic bonding -van der Waal' bonding (forces) -hydrogen bonding
lessons.assignments: Read the relevant part of the textbook beforehand and prepare to be able to answer the exercise problems.

lessons.content: Introduction to three phases of matter I -solid, liquid, and gas -melting and solidification (freezing) -vaporizing and condensation -sublimation -phase diagram of water
lessons.assignments: Read the relevant part of the textbook beforehand and prepare to be able to answer the exercise problems.

lessons.content: Introduction to three phases of matter II -phase diagram of CO2 -dispersions and their types -suspension, colloids, and solutions
lessons.assignments: Read the relevant part of the textbook beforehand and prepare to be able to answer the exercise problems.
